clips.title: The story
paras: Bingles Blastenheimer is stranded on Loch Modan's southeastern shore after troggs steal his gear. He needs his tools and Blastencapper explosives to repair his gyrocopter and return to the fight for Gnomeregan.

Bingles Blastenheimer crashes his gyrocopter into Loch Modan's cold waters. He survives and drags himself ashore, but troggs from the lake's central islands swarm the dazed pilot and steal his most valuable belongings.

Troggs scatter Bingles' gear among their island camps. His missing supplies include a wrench, screwdriver, and hammer, along with the Blastenheimer Blastencapper, his volatile, high-yield invention. Losing ordinary tools is troublesome; leaving explosives in a region crawling with troggs puts travelers in immediate danger.

Bingles fights for the liberation of his fallen homeland, Gnomeregan. It is overrun by subterranean troggs and irradiated leper gnomes, and he imagines a decisive aerial assault to break their hold. Without his tools and Blastencappers, he cannot rebuild his flying machine, and his campaign remains grounded in the reeds.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: As if crashing into the Loch wasn't bad enough, troggs from the nearby island attacked me and stole my tools and special Blastenheimer Blastencapper explosives. With no gyrocopter and no explosives, the movement has no chance!
Get my tools back and find my Blastencapper explosives, friend. For Gnomeregan!

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've done the movement a great service, friend. The troggs and leper gnomes infesting Gnomeregan will soon feel the brunt of a gnomish air assault!
